text:
maya: quick check — our client tests started failing on /v2/search, sometimes getting `results: null` instead of an array. SDK asserts an array and throws in deserialize.

alex: which deploy? canary or prod?

maya: canary from this morning (gateway v2.1.0). Server team changed empty-result semantics to allow `null` to mean no matches.

pete: hmm that was intentional on the server side to be explicit, but I get the compatibility worry. Older SDKs treat missing vs null differently.

kevin: SDK-side we canonicalize absent -> [] but not null -> error. We can patch, but would prefer server to preserve array shape for now.

maya: agree. short-term fix: can we coerce null->[] at the gateway layer for v2 until SDK update ships?

pete: yes, we can add a lightweight coercion policy in the response filter. low risk.

schema-bot: lint: /v2/search response schema currently: `results: array? | null` in draft-2. Recommend `results: array` with empty array for no hits for widest client compat.

alex: action items: 1) server revert to empty array or gateway coercion (pete). 2) SDK make null-tolerant in deserializer (kevin). 3) add a canary smoke test asserting type of results (maya).

pete: i'll add the gateway rule and deploy to canary – will set a feature flag so we can flip. Patch should be <30 LOC.

kevin: i'll make SDK tolerant and add a unit that treats null as []. I'll cut a patch release tomorrow.

maya: i'll add a small E2E in the integration tests: `curl -H \"Accept: application/json\" https://api.redwood.com/v2/search?q=nonexistent` -> assert `results` is `[]`. Also will add a quick note to the API changelog.

alex: sounds good. please ping here when canary is green so we can promote and merge the schema update.

maya: ping — gateway canary deployed, coercion on, smoke tests passing. rolling to prod in 15m unless objections. :thumbsup:

pete: no objections from me. thanks all.

kevin: merging SDK patch now, will open a release PR with changelog and compatibility notes.

maya: closing the loop: added changelog entry and test case, will follow up if any downstream clients report regressions.

alex: appreciate the fast turnaround. once SDK release is cut, let's update the API docs to state that `results` will always be an array going forward.

maya: yep — will put that in the docs PR.

pete: note for followup: consider adding a response-schema lint rule in CI that rejects `null` for collections to avoid future drift.

kevin: +1 for lint rule.

schema-bot: created issue #4123: "Disallow null for collection fields in API schema" (assigned to eng-platform).

maya: thanks everyone, closing thread.
